IC1: Be categorized as American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) Physical Status Class 1 [OR], 2 [OR], or 3.
IC2: Have a planned non-emergent surgical procedure  [OR]or clinical situation (e.g., intubation) that requires moderate  [OR]or deep NMB with either rocuronium  [OR]or vecuronium.
IC3: Have a planned surgical procedure o [OR]r clinical situation that would allow objective neuromuscular monitoring techniques to be applied with access to the arm for neuromuscular transmission monitoring.
IC4: Age between 2 to <17 years at Visit 2.
IC5: If female, may participate if she is not [NOT] pregnant, not [NOT] breastfeeding, and at least one of the following: 1) Not [NOT] a woman of childbearing potential (WOCBP); or [OR] 2) A WOCBP who agrees to follow the study contraceptive guidance during the treatment period and [OR] for at least 7 days after the last dose of study treatment.
